verdicts.reason: Both break the same way. The magnifier icon was pulled out of the search bar, leaving an empty slot in the bar, and blown up into a huge, pixelated glyph that dominates the orange block and outweighs the 'ONLINE COURSE' headline. The photo is shrunk into a small inset that floats in a white band with dead space below it, and 'PPC CAMPAIGNS' and 'HOW TO LEVEL UP' are tiny. A is only marginally better because its photo is wider and fills the lower area a little more, while B's narrower photo leaves larger white side margins.
